name: ActivityPub Comment
description: Federates Drupal comments over ActivityPub: turns inbound replies into local comments and mirrors local comments to the Fediverse.
project_description: Submodule of the ActivityPub project that integrates with the core Comment module. It provides an ActivityPub type plugin ('activitypub_comment') and an 'inbox_reply' type so that inbound Create activities that are replies to a local node become local comments (with a configurable comment type, body field, filter format and status), and local comments referencing an activity can be federated back out. Deleting the source activity deletes the mirrored comment. Also exposes a comment as ActivityPub/IndieWeb JSON.
